source.name: Lexique 4 (French lexical database)
source.citation: New, B., Pallier, C., Schalchli, G., Bourgin, J., & Gimenes, M. (2026). Lexique 4: A major upgrade of the Lexique French lexical database. Behavior Research Methods. https://doi.org/10.3758/s13428-026-02967-5

notes: Retrieved 2026-08-27 from the official lexique.org distribution by the developer-dispatched GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/lexique-source.yml; the interactive build environment's egress allowlist does not include lexique.org). The run downloaded the artifact twice and both downloads hashed identically to the pinned sha256; the raw 33,067,258-byte TSV (189,863 data rows, UTF-8, no BOM) is retained as a workflow run artifact only and is never committed. Identity, real header, per-column profile and sample rows are committed in derived/lexique4-recon.json; the official README (license CC BY-SA 4.0 and citation) is committed as derived/README-Lexique400.txt. The 37 column names above are the REAL Lexique 4.00 header, confirmed against the artifact — column roles are documented in LEXIQUE4_COLUMNS.md. Phonology: 2_Phono is Lexique's ASCII phonological alphabet (never label it IPA); 3_Phono_IPA is a dedicated genuine-IPA column (verified glyph inventory — see LEXIQUE4_COLUMNS.md), so IPA-labeled pronunciation may cite lexique-4 only when taken verbatim from 3_Phono_IPA. Any future retrieval that does not hash to the pinned sha256 is source-version drift and must fail loudly (verify mode enforces this).
